name: BizPay Lipa na Mpesa for Woocommerce
author: devnesh

sections.description:
BizPay Lipa na M-Pesa Payment Gateway allows WooCommerce stores to receive M-Pesa payments directly into their KCB bank accounts using Buni’s secure API.
Payments made via M-Pesa are instantly credited to your KCB account.

Features

  • Seamless integration with WooCommerce checkout
  • Easy Setup: Simple and intuitive settings page in your WooCommerce admin panel to configure your Buni API credentials.
  • Secure Transactions: All transactions are processed through KCB\’s secure Buni API, ensuring customer data protection.
  • Automatic order status updates in WooCommerce.
  • Real-time Status Updates: Provides instant feedback on payment status to the customer
  • Supports both Sandbox and Production environments for testing and live transactions.
sections.installation:
1. Install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the \’Plugins\’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and configure the BizPay Lipa na M-Pesa Payment Gateway with your API credentials.
sections.faq:
What do I need to use this plugin?

You need a KCB bank account and API credentials from KCB.

Where do i get KCB Buni API Credentials?

You can get your Consumer Key, Consumer Secret from the KCB Buni Developer Portal > Applications > Select your application > Sandbox/Production Oauth Keys

Is this plugin secure?

Yes, all payment requests and callbacks are securely handled using Buni\’s API and WooCommerce best practices.
